subject: dr:aviso:14352/2025/2
title: PDM de Celorico de Basto, 2.ª revisão (Aviso n.º 14352/2025/2, DR 2.ª série n.º 108, 2025-06-05): what can be built on a parcel, by category of space
note: Quotes are checked word for word against the official PDF's text, with the page headers removed and words broken at line ends joined. The category of a parcel comes from the planta de ordenamento (DGT's CRUS service gives it by coordinates, engine/geo.py): it is an input here. IUL applies to the part of the parcel within 50 m of the public road (80 m in economic-activity spaces), IUB beyond it (art. 54.º n.º 2); the abstract buildability is the IUL figure unless the câmara accepts the IUB part (n.º 3).

general.what: new buildings in urban soil need the parcel to be served by the infrastructures and to front an enabling public road (or be in a licensed allotment)
general.quote: A construção de novos edifícios em solo urbano só pode ser viabilizada

general.what: impermeabilised area ≤ twice the building footprint and ≤ 90 % of the parcel
general.quote: não pode ultrapassar o dobro da área de implantação total dos referidos edifícios nem 90 % da área total do prédio

general.what: in a consolidated urban front, the index is the starting reference and integration with the surroundings may prevail (cércea = the most frequent of the front)
general.quote: constitui o referencial de princípio para a edificabilidade a viabilizar

general.what: IUL within 50 m of the public road (80 m in economic-activity spaces), IUB beyond
general.quote: O IUL aplica-se à parte da área do prédio abrangida pela referida categoria ou subcategoria

general.what: occupation of the parcel with buildings, including basements and annexes: 75 % if the parcel has 333,3 m² or more, else 250 m²
